disorder-name.detail: Pathogenic CNV carriers from UK Biobank; 92 CNVs proposed to be pathogenic including their reciprocal variants. Primary examples highlighted: 1q21.1 deletion (n=5 in Jacobian analysis) and 1q21.1 duplication (n=5 in Jacobian analysis). Supplementary analyses also include 15q11.2, 16p11.2, and 16p13.11 deletion/duplication carriers. Two analytical pipelines apply the NM to CNV carriers: Analysis 1 (IDP-level, UKB-IDP-CNV, N=263) and Analysis 2 (whole-brain Jacobian, UKB-CNV, N=375).
disorder-name.supporting_text: "We focused on 92 CNVs proposed to be pathogenic (henceforth 'pathogenic') and their reciprocal CNVs"

dataset-of-origin.detail: Both clinical cohort subsets are drawn from UK Biobank: Analysis 1 (UKB-IDP-CNV, N=263) and Analysis 2 (UKB-CNV, N=375). Genetic CNV data requested under UK Biobank application number 23668.
dataset-of-origin.supporting_text: "applied these models to understand the neurobiological profile of CNV carriers in the UK Biobank cohort"

age.detail: モデル別の値：Analysis 1 (IDP, UKB-IDP-CNV, N=263): mean 62.97 (SD 8.70), range 46–80 years; Analysis 2 (Jacobian, UKB-CNV, N=375): mean 63.58 (SD 7.48), range 46–80 years. The two analyses represent different subsets of UK Biobank pathogenic CNV carriers processed with different QC criteria (automated vs. visual QC).
